text:
maria: Quick async summary — end-of-quarter outcomes and owners. TL;DR: runtime-v2 is prod, embeddings infra slipped on driver, prompt-editor UX delayed. Need owners/next steps.

alex: Nice, can you paste the SLO link? Also any major customer impact yet?

maria: No major customer impact reported. Attaching short list:
- Shipped: runtime-v2 (canary -> prod), plugin-api-v1
- Slipped: embeddings-infra (driver mismatch), prompt-editor UX deploy (e2e flakes)
- Blockers: kernel driver mismatch on dedicated nodes, flaky UX tests, pending SSO cert rotation for Private deploy customers
- Owners: runtime -> alex, embeddings -> priya, UX -> jon

priya: Embeddings slipped because CUDA drivers on the Dedicated pool are mismatched (we saw OOM/crashes on quantized kernels). Filed ENG-INFRA-422 with logs. ETA depends on infra rolling the driver.

jon: UX deploy blocked by flaky e2e failures in staging. I can spare one engineer next week to isolate flakiness and cut a hotfix. If infra can spare the extra node for a repro, that'd speed it up.

alex: Runtime metrics look stable post-rollout so far (p95 latency within target). I'll add an SLO alert for latency/regression. Link: https://console.redwood/metrics/runtime-v2-slo :thumbsup:

eng-infra-bot: Deploy job failed on 3 nodes: kernel-driver-version mismatch. Logs: ```ERROR: kernel module incompatible with cuDNN 8.7; process 0x3f failed allocation; see /var/log/deploy/422.log```

sam: Capacity note — we can temporarily shift 2 nodes from staging to Dedicated to re-run validation if that helps unblock embeddings. Will need approval window (2h).

maria: Proposal/decisions: prioritize embeddings driver bump this week (blocker), shift 2 staging nodes if infra approves, push UX deploy by 1 sprint and allocate eng to fix e2e. Action items: 
- priya: coordinate with eng-infra on ENG-INFRA-422; confirm ETA and required steps (driver, re-validation)
- alex: add SLO alert and watchlist for runtime-v2; share any anomalous traces
- jon: freeze non-critical UX changes, prepare hotfix plan and test isolation steps
- sam/eng-infra: confirm node shift feasibility and schedule (if agreed)

maria: Please ack in-thread with ETA where applicable; I'll compile a short leadership note after ack.

alex: ack — will set up the SLO alert by EOD and monitor.

priya: ack — pinging infra now, will update ENG-INFRA-422 with repro and ETA (aiming for 48h).

jon: ack — will start isolation on Monday and aim to have a remediation plan by mid-week.

sam: ack — holding 2 nodes in staging, will release only on infra approval.

maria: thanks all. I'll draft the short blurb for execs: one-paragraph status + owners + 48h ask. If anything changes, reply here so I can update the note. :white_check_mark:
